title: Definitely take this tour!
text: We had really great tour guides who were very nice and interesting.  We really enjoyed this tour-from climbing the Giralda to seeing Columbus’ final resting place!
author: Carol_K

title: Beautiful cathedral—book ahead!
text: Don’t miss this cathedral! Definitely worth getting a guided tour. It is so massive you won’t know what you are looking at on your own. You really need to book ahead because the tickets sell out!!
author: Adventure656153

title: A great guide!
text:
Santiago really helped us outside the Cathedral and booked us on to an incredibly reasonably priced tour, which (perhaps incidentally) turned out to be private. Both Santiago and our guide Jesus(!) were incredibly patient with our questions and forthcoming with knowledge and tips.

Santiago even offered to help us book other experiences such as restaurants and flamenco performances.

Honestly, I initially thought this was a scam, but I was 100% wrong.
author: J9650MMmeganh
